headline: Argentina Country Risk Rises to 831 Points and Stocks Fall
summary: Argentina's country risk rose to about 831 points and domestic shares fell as doubts grew over 2027 debt payments, amid fiscal stabilization concerns.
why: Sovereign risk gauges reflect investor confidence in a country's fiscal policy stability and its capacity to service upcoming foreign debt obligations.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Argentina's risk gauge rose and local stocks fell due to debt payment doubts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
